issue.body: A *.xlsx open normaly in local pc but get a broken xlsx file throught FileResponse. And do not find any error code in this code: try: tmp_file = StaticsConfig().ExcelTemplateFilePath if not os.path.exists(tmp_file): log.error( f"download_example_excel_file error: Standard Template file not found {tmp_file} ") raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Standard Template file not found") file_name = os.path.basename(tmp_file) headers = {'Content-Disposition': f'attachment; filename="{file_name}"'} return FileResponse(tmp_file, headers=headers) except Exception as e: log.error(f"download_example_excel_file error") return JSONResponse( status_code=500, content={"code": 1, "msg": "Internal server error"}, ) > [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
